title: No test checks that an unknown /api address answers "Not found"
what: The server answers any /api address it does not know with a plain "Not found". No test asks for such an address on any host, so a change that served the admin app page or crashed there would pass every check.
expected: A test asks for a made-up /api address on each host and sees a 404 "Not found", never the app page or a 500.
fix_line: Add one test that asks for a made-up /api address on each host and checks the 404 answer

title: No test checks that the demo form saves nothing while the landing page is hidden
what: When the landing page switch is off, the demo form address should answer "Not found" and save no lead. Every lead test runs with the switch on, so a lead saved while the page is hidden would not be caught.
expected: A test with the landing switch off posts a lead and sees a 404 with nothing saved.
fix_line: Add a lead test with the landing switch off that checks the 404 and that nothing was saved

title: No test sends a zero, tiny or huge amount to a payment request
what: The server refuses a payment request whose amount is under Rs 1 or above the cap, for desk dues and shop orders. No test ever sends such an amount, so a change that let a zero or wrong amount make a payment link would pass.
expected: A test sends a zero, a negative, a tiny and a too-large amount and sees BAD_AMOUNT with no request saved and no company link made.
fix_line: Add a payment test that sends bad amounts and checks the refusal, no saved request and no link

title: No test checks that a payment held by a closed desk frees up after 5 minutes
what: When a desk taps Approve on a paid-online payment it holds it for 5 minutes. If that desk closes the app, the hold should run out so another desk can make the receipt. No test moves the clock past the hold, so a payment stuck as taken for ever would pass.
expected: A test holds a payment, moves the clock past 5 minutes, and sees the payment back in the list and taken by a second desk.
how_often: when a desk closes during Approve
fix_line: Add a payment test that holds, waits past 5 minutes, and holds again from another desk

title: No test checks what a member sees when the gym turns off paying in the app
what: With "Take payments in the member app" off, the member should still see the amount and label but no payment page, QR or UPI link. One test makes such a request for another member but never reads what that member is shown, and no test covers a link looked at again after it expired.
expected: A test makes a request with in-app payment off and checks the member sees amount and label with no link or UPI; another checks a fresh link replaces an expired one.
fix_line: Add a member payment test with the switch off that reads what the member is sent

title: No test checks that the move keeps a sign-in the new address already has
what: The move page skips the hand-over when the new address already has a sign-in, so keys of two gyms never mix. The move test only starts from an empty new address, so a change that wrote the old sign-in over a newer one would pass.
expected: A test signs the desk in on the new address first, then moves from the old address, and sees the new address keep its own sign-in.
fix_line: Add a move test where the new address is already signed in to another gym

title: No test checks the safety lines on answers passed through our gym server address
what: Every answer passed on from the gym server gets two lines that stop the browser running it as a page, so it can never read the desk sign-in. No test checks those two lines, so removing them by mistake would pass every check.
expected: The pass-through test checks every passed-on answer carries the no-sniffing and sandbox lines.
fix_line: Add two checks to the pass-through test for the two safety lines

title: No test sends a live-update connection through our gym server address
what: Live-update connections take their own path through our address. No test sends one, so a change that broke them would pass.
expected: A test sends a connection upgrade through our address and sees it passed on unchanged.
fix_line: Add a test for a connection upgrade request through our address

title: No test checks the owner key stays out of the AI Assistant request and logs
what: The member help box test checks the member key is never sent to the AI or saved. The owner AI Assistant has no such check, so a change that put the owner sign-in key into the AI request or a log would pass.
expected: An AI Assistant test checks the owner key is not in the AI request, the saved rows or the log lines.
fix_line: Add the same key-not-sent checks the member help test has to the AI Assistant test
